title.en: Isagi’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Isagi is one of seven anime characters selected for this independent fan edition. His angle here is observing a tabletop turn and revising a paper layout. It does not score intelligence, spatial ability, learning speed or an ability to win at football. A small revision is simply one enjoyable way to explore how an invented game works without treating another player as an obstacle to destroy.
paragraphs.zh: 洁世一是本独立同人版选定七动画人物之一，角度是观察桌面回合、修改纸布局，不评智力、空间能力、学习速度或足球获胜能力。小修改只是探索自编游戏怎样运作的乐趣，不把别人当须摧毁的障碍。

title.en: A connection changes after a replay

paragraphs.en: You thought two counters could connect easily, but a sample turn shows that the paper rule leaves a gap. You redraw one line and try again with the group’s agreement. The useful observation is specific to this little layout. It does not prove that you read real opponents accurately, copy people successfully or need to dismantle your identity whenever a plan stops working.
paragraphs.zh: 原以为两棋子易连接，示例却显示纸规则有缺口。你经大家同意重画一线、再试。有用观察只关这小布局，不证明看穿真人对手、成功模仿或每次计划失效都需推翻自我。

title.en: Observation beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Bachira tries a playful variation, Nagi starts with a simple move and Reo chooses a different contribution. Rin clarifies the plan, Barou uses a personal routine and Chigiri chooses the tempo. Isagi’s selected angle updates the map after watching. These contributions can coexist without ranking intelligence or ambition. Tied guides offer several readings of your choices, not evidence of competing selves or a hidden talent profile.
paragraphs.zh: 蜂乐试趣味变化，凪从简单走步开始，玲王选不同贡献；凛澄清计划，马狼用个人惯例，千切选节奏。洁的角度看后改图。可共存，不排智力、野心；并列给多读法，不证明自我冲突、隐藏天赋。

title.en: A useful revision does not require endless analysis
title.zh: 有用修改不需无尽分析

paragraphs.en: It can be tempting to keep replaying a small turn instead of enjoying the next one. Decide whether the observation changes anything the group wants to try now, and leave the rest for later. Your count cannot establish exceptional perception or relentless competitiveness. A lower count does not imply poor awareness, weak reasoning or an inability to learn, and an invented game is not a model of every real situation.
paragraphs.zh: 反复回放小回合可能替代继续玩。可决定观察是否影响现在想试的，其他留后。次数不确立超强观察、无休竞争；低计数不表示觉察差、推理弱、不会学，虚构游戏也不代表所有现实。

title.en: Try one observation and one reversible change
title.zh: 试一次观察与可改回变化

paragraphs.en: In a voluntary paper game, watch one sample turn and note one concrete connection that could be clearer. Ask the group whether to test a small revision, then compare how the two layouts play. Keep either or neither. You are checking a design choice, not measuring your brain, proving superiority over friends or receiving advice about competitive sport, professional performance or major life decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 自愿纸游戏中，看一示例、记一个可更清楚连接，问大家是否试小改，再比两布局玩法。可留任一或都不留。这核设计，不测大脑、不证明优于朋友、不指导竞技、职业表现或重大决定。

title.en: Bachira’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Bachira’s selected angle is a playful variation in a harmless tabletop game, offered so everyone can freely accept or decline. It is not a measure of eccentricity, intuition, loneliness or a need for approval. You do not need an unusual identity to enjoy moving paper counters differently, and nobody’s discomfort has to become the entertainment. The match makes no claim about your football technique or creative talent.
paragraphs.zh: 蜂乐角度是无害桌游的趣味变式，人人能自由接受或拒绝。不测古怪、直觉、孤独或求认可需要。享受不同纸棋子走法无需特殊身份，也不拿谁的不适作娱乐；匹配不评足球技术、创作天赋。

title.en: An unexpected move with an ordinary invitation

paragraphs.en: A familiar round has become repetitive. You suggest a counter pattern that reverses one harmless rule and explain it before anyone plays. If the group prefers the old version, the suggestion can wait. The example is about shared playfulness, not imposing a surprise, embarrassing a friend or treating fictional inner voices and monsters as explanations for real thoughts or mental-health experiences.
paragraphs.zh: 熟悉一轮重复，你提棋子图样，反转一条无害规则，并先解释再玩。若大家喜欢旧版，可等。这是共同玩趣，不强加惊喜、不使朋友难堪、不用虚构内心声音、怪物解释现实思想或心理体验。

title.en: Playfulness beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Isagi revises after observing, Nagi finds a simple starting move and Reo explores a chosen role. Rin specifies the shared plan, Barou prepares with his own routine and Chigiri chooses a comfortable tempo. Bachira’s angle offers an agreed playful alternative. None is a rank in originality or social worth. A tie can mean several enjoyable contributions without assigning abandonment fears, hidden emotional needs or permanent labels.
paragraphs.zh: 洁观察后改，凪找简单首步，玲王探索自选角色；凛具体写共同计划，马狼按个人惯例准备，千切选舒服节奏。蜂乐给约好玩趣替代。不排原创性、价值；并列不派被弃恐惧、隐藏情感需要、永久标签。

title.en: A variation can remain only an idea

paragraphs.en: Not every playful idea needs to become a rule. A group may want familiarity, a shorter round or no further game today. You can enjoy imagining an alternative while accepting that choice. A higher count cannot prove unusual creativity or instinctive skill, and a lower count cannot show rigidity, isolation or a lack of joy. Shared consent matters more than making the session look spontaneous.
paragraphs.zh: 非每个趣味点子都需成规则，大家可要熟悉、短轮或今天不再玩。可享受想象同时接受选择。高计数不证明独特创意、本能技术，低计数不表示僵硬、孤立、没乐趣；共同同意比显得即兴重要。

title.en: Try a clearly optional variation

paragraphs.en: For one small paper round, offer an imaginative move and describe how people can decline it. If they agree, try it once and ask whether the game became more enjoyable or merely more complicated. Return to the earlier version if preferred. This explores a leisure choice, not your need for connection, psychological independence, athletic instincts or ability to overcome a difficult personal history.
paragraphs.zh: 给小纸回合提想象走法，说明怎样拒绝。同意则试一次，问更好玩还是只更复杂；可回旧版。这探索闲暇选择，不评联结需要、心理独立、运动本能或克服个人困难经历能力。

title.en: Nagi’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Nagi’s name anchors a simple first attempt in this original tabletop bank. The angle does not measure laziness, natural genius, boredom or a hidden potential waiting to awaken. Beginning with one easy counter move can be a way to enjoy an optional hobby without committing to an elaborate sequence. It says nothing about how much effort you owe a group or how talented you are at sport.
paragraphs.zh: 凪在原创桌面题本对应简单首试，不测懒惰、天才、无聊或待觉醒潜力。从一个易走步开始，可让人无需承诺复杂序列就享受爱好，不说欠小组多少努力、不评体育天赋。

title.en: One turn before the whole system

paragraphs.en: Friends have designed a long tabletop sequence that takes a while to explain. You ask to try a single small part so everybody can see what it does. The group might enjoy that short round or decide to build more later. The useful feature is an approachable starting point, not effortless brilliance or proof that other people should supply your motivation and do the preparation for you.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友设计长序列、解释很久。你提先试一小部分，让大家见其作用。可享受短轮，也可后续再扩。有用处是好开始，不是毫不费力的天才，也不说别人应供动力、代准备。

title.en: Simplicity beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Isagi learns about the layout by observing, Bachira offers a playful variation and Reo chooses a contribution. Rin clarifies details, Barou keeps a personal preparation routine and Chigiri chooses a tempo. Nagi’s selected angle makes the first move small enough to try. These can support the same session without ranking effort or talent. A tie does not reveal dormant ability, emotional indifference or a fixed motivational type.
paragraphs.zh: 洁观察布局，蜂乐提趣味变式，玲王选贡献；凛澄清细节，马狼留个人准备惯例，千切选节奏。凪让首步小到能试。可支持同活动，不排努力、天赋；并列不揭潜力、情感冷漠、固定动力类型。

title.en: Simple does not mean ignoring shared work
title.zh: 简单不等于无视共同工作

paragraphs.en: A short version still needs the materials and agreement that make it playable. If a friend has offered to explain a rule, respect that contribution rather than assuming the game should arrive ready for you. A count cannot establish apathy or genius. A lower count does not mean overthinking, and a larger project can be enjoyable too when that is what participants actually want to make.
paragraphs.zh: 短版也需可玩的材料、约定。朋友自愿解释规则，可尊重其贡献，不默认游戏应替你全备好。次数不确立冷漠、天才，低计数不表示想太多；若大家真想做，大项目也可好玩。

title.en: Try a one-turn version

paragraphs.en: Take a voluntary paper-game idea and ask what a single playable turn would need. Set up only that part with willing friends, play once and decide whether to continue. Notice whether the smaller beginning made the activity easier to enjoy. This is feedback on scope, not a test of motivation, a claim about innate skill or an instruction to avoid effort in school, work or sport.
paragraphs.zh: 问自愿纸游戏一个可玩回合需什么，同愿意朋友只备这部分，玩一次再决定继续否。看小开头是否更好享受。这反馈范围，不测动力、不说天赋、不指导在学业、工作、运动中避努力。

title.en: Reo’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Reo’s selected angle is choosing a contribution with room to change it by agreement. It does not measure versatility, wealth, dependence or your worth apart from a friend. You can enjoy arranging counters now and writing rules later without needing to mirror another person or prove independence. The match describes choices in a voluntary paper activity, not an account of how your close relationships work.
paragraphs.zh: 玲王角度是选贡献并留约好再改空间，不测多才、财富、依赖或离开朋友后的价值。可现在摆棋子、后写规则，不需模仿别人、证明独立。匹配描述自愿纸活动选择，不解释亲密关系运作。

title.en: A new part becomes interesting

paragraphs.en: After arranging the paper pitch, you become curious about writing an example rule. You ask whether somebody wants to swap contributions or whether you can take a new small part. The change follows an interest you have now. Nobody needs to lose a partner or be replaced as a person, and a different task does not make the earlier contribution less meaningful.
paragraphs.zh: 摆好纸球场后，你好奇写示例规则，问有谁想换贡献、能否接新小部分。变化跟随当前兴趣。无人需失去伙伴、被当人替换，换任务不使先前贡献失去意义。

title.en: Role choice beside six other contributions
title.zh: 角色选择与另六种贡献

paragraphs.en: Isagi observes and revises, Bachira offers play and Nagi begins simply. Rin defines details, Barou uses a personal routine and Chigiri chooses the tempo. Reo’s selected angle keeps the contribution a choice rather than a permanent assignment. Several angles can coexist without ranking versatility or relationship health. A tie does not show that you lack an identity, and no character count decides who you need beside you.
paragraphs.zh: 洁观察修改，蜂乐提玩趣，凪简单开始；凛定义细节，马狼用个人惯例，千切选节奏。玲王让贡献保持选择、不成永久指派。可共存，不排多才、关系健康；并列不说无身份，次数不决定需要谁陪伴。

title.en: Changing a task includes communicating it

paragraphs.en: A group can struggle if people silently leave parts they had agreed to finish. Say what you want to change and check which small commitments still need a handover. You can also decide to stop an optional activity. Your count cannot establish adaptability or unhealthy attachment, and a lower count does not mean inflexibility, isolation or an inability to contribute in more than one way.
paragraphs.zh: 默默丢下约好部分可使小组困难，可说想改什么，核哪些小承诺要交接，也能决定停可选活动。次数不确立适应力、不健康依恋；低计数不表示不灵活、孤立或只能单一贡献。

title.en: Try a clearly agreed role change
title.zh: 试一次清楚约好的角色变化

paragraphs.en: At a voluntary tabletop session, name one contribution you would like to try next and ask how to change parts without leaving an agreed task unclear. Try it for one round, then decide again. Notice whether the new part was enjoyable rather than treating flexibility as proof of worth. This is a hobby experiment, not advice about separation, identity, attachment or significant relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 自愿桌面活动中，说想试哪贡献，问怎样换才不使约好任务含糊。试一轮再选，注意是否有趣，不把灵活当价值证明。这试爱好，不建议分离、身份、依恋或重要关系。

paragraphs.en: Rin’s name anchors precise, agreed planning for a small paper game. The angle does not measure coldness, perfectionism, aggression or a need to surpass a sibling. A clear example can help friends understand what a counter move means without turning them into opponents whose pride must be crushed. Precision here concerns one invented rule, not your emotional style, intelligence or ability to dominate a real competition.
paragraphs.zh: 凛对应小纸游戏精确、约好的规划，不测冷漠、完美主义、攻击或超越手足需要。清楚例子帮朋友懂棋子走法，不把人当须击碎自尊对手。精确只关自编规则，不关情感风格、智力、现实竞技支配力。

title.en: A written rule meets a sample turn
title.zh: 书面规则遇上示例回合

paragraphs.en: Two friends read the same paper instruction differently. You write a short sequence of steps and ask them to check it against a sample move. If the example reveals a mismatch, the group agrees a correction. The aim is a shared understanding people can use, not catching someone out, proving that your interpretation is superior or making the activity depend on flawless execution.
paragraphs.zh: 两朋友对纸说明读法不同，你写短步骤，邀对着示例核。若发现不合，小组约修正。目的是可用共同理解，不抓错、不证明解释更高、不要求无瑕执行才可玩。

title.en: Precision beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Isagi revises from observation, Bachira offers a playful move and Nagi starts with a simple part. Reo chooses a contribution, Barou uses a personal routine and Chigiri chooses the tempo. Rin’s selected angle clarifies the shared example. None is a rank in rationality or competence. A tie can suggest several useful approaches without assigning emotional suppression, a sibling conflict or a hidden psychological explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 洁从观察改，蜂乐提趣味走法，凪由小部分开始；玲王选贡献，马狼用个人惯例，千切选节奏。凛澄清共同例子。不排理性、胜任；并列可提示多方法，不派情绪压抑、手足冲突、隐藏心理解释。

title.en: The example should serve the game

paragraphs.en: A precise rule can become so detailed that nobody wants to read it. Check whether each added step solves an actual confusion and simplify the rest together. Your count cannot establish perfectionism, emotional distance or superior reasoning. A lower count does not mean carelessness, and a group may choose a looser rule when that makes the voluntary activity more enjoyable for the people taking part.
paragraphs.zh: 精确规则也会细到无人想读。核每新增步是否解实际困惑，共同简化其余。次数不确立完美主义、情感疏远、推理更高；低计数不表示粗心，若参与者更享受也可选较松规则。

title.en: Try one checkable example

paragraphs.en: Choose one harmless paper rule and write a short example that willing players can follow. Ask where the wording leaves more than one interpretation, then agree one revision. Stop when it is clear enough for the next round. You are evaluating an instruction, not testing emotional control, comparing yourself with family members or deciding whether you can outperform other people in serious competition.
paragraphs.zh: 选一无害纸规则，写自愿玩家能跟的短例，问哪文字有多解，约一修改；够清楚能玩下轮即可。此评说明，不测情绪控制、不比家人、不决定能否在严肃竞技胜人。

title.en: Barou’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Barou’s selected angle is a repeatable routine for preparing your own paper pieces. It does not include ruling the group, treating friends as supporting characters or demanding perfection. You can like placing counters in a familiar order without requiring others to copy it. The match does not measure dominance, compulsions, discipline, physical power or a right to set standards for everyone at the table.
paragraphs.zh: 马狼角度是可重复准备自己纸棋子的惯例，不含统治小组、当朋友为配角、要求完美。可爱熟悉摆序，不要求照搬。不测支配、强迫、纪律、力量或替全桌定标准资格。

title.en: A personal reset that stays personal

paragraphs.en: Your pieces have become mixed with spare paper. You choose a small place-and-reset order for your own materials so you know what is ready. A friend may organise differently and still play the same agreed game. The useful boundary is that your routine belongs to your contribution; neatness is not a judgment of another person’s effort, respect, competence or willingness to take the hobby seriously.
paragraphs.zh: 棋子混到备用纸中，你给自己的材料选放置、复位小顺序，好知备什么。朋友可另整理、仍玩同约游戏。有用边界是惯例属于自己的贡献；整齐不判断别人的努力、尊重、能力、是否认真爱好。

title.en: Routine beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Isagi observes and changes the layout, Bachira tries a playful variation and Nagi starts simply. Reo chooses a role, Rin clarifies the plan and Chigiri chooses the tempo. Barou’s selected angle prepares his own materials consistently. These contributions are not a hierarchy of discipline or strength. A tie does not prove a controlling personality, and a high count never assigns a fictional character’s harmful behaviour to you.
paragraphs.zh: 洁观察改布局，蜂乐试趣味变化，凪简单开始；玲王选角色，凛澄清计划，千切选节奏。马狼一致准备自己材料。不是纪律、力量等级；并列不证明控制型人格，高计数不把虚构伤害赋给你。

title.en: A routine can change with the activity

paragraphs.en: The same arrangement may stop helping when the paper game changes. You can revise the routine, use only part of it or skip it without losing a personal identity. Your count cannot establish obsessive behaviour, leadership ability or a need for control. A lower count does not mean disorder, weak commitment or poor self-management, and friends do not owe one another identical preparation habits.
paragraphs.zh: 纸游戏变后，同布局可能无益。可改惯例、只用部分、跳过，不失个人身份。次数不确立强迫行为、领导能力、控制需要；低计数不表示混乱、承诺弱、管理差，朋友不欠彼此同准备习惯。

title.en: Try one personal setup habit

paragraphs.en: Before a voluntary counter session, choose a small setup order for your own pieces and leave other people’s arrangements alone. After a round, ask whether it helped you find what you needed. Keep, change or drop it according to that answer. This explores a practical preference, not a diagnosis, a discipline score or permission to control the way friends organise their belongings.
paragraphs.zh: 自愿棋子活动前，为自己选小摆序，不动别人安排。一轮后问是否帮找到所需，依回答留、改或删。这探索实际偏好，不作诊断、纪律分数、不许可控制朋友怎样放物品。

title.en: Chigiri’s selected angle

paragraphs.en: Chigiri’s selected angle is choosing a comfortable tempo for an optional tabletop activity. It does not measure running speed, courage, injury recovery or readiness to return to sport. Nobody needs to overcome a medical history, bodily limitation or fear to fit this guide. The paper game can include pauses, slower turns or sitting a round out, with no inference about your fitness or psychological resilience.
paragraphs.zh: 千切角度是选可选桌面活动舒服节奏，不测跑速、勇气、伤后恢复、重返运动准备。无需克服病史、身体限制、恐惧以合指南。纸游戏可暂停、慢走、略过一轮，不推断体能、心理韧性。

title.en: A pause is part of the available choices

paragraphs.en: Friends suggest the quickest possible token round. You say which pace you want and ask whether the game can include a pause between moves. They can agree another version, and you can choose whether to join. The scene concerns a leisure preference, not pressure to push past pain, conceal a condition, demonstrate bravery or imitate a fictional player’s return to competition.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友建议最快棋子轮，你说想要节奏，问可否走间暂停。可约另一版，你能决定参加否。场景关闲暇偏好，不迫越疼痛、隐瞒状况、证明勇敢、模仿虚构球员重返比赛。

title.en: Tempo beside six other contributions

paragraphs.en: Isagi revises a layout, Bachira offers play and Nagi starts with a small move. Reo chooses a contribution, Rin clarifies the plan and Barou keeps a personal routine. Chigiri’s selected angle chooses the tempo rather than accepting quickness as a standard. These can coexist without ranking bravery or bodily ability. A tie cannot establish trauma, an injury history or how you should handle a health decision.
paragraphs.zh: 洁改布局，蜂乐提玩趣，凪由小走步开始；玲王选贡献，凛澄清计划，马狼留个人惯例。千切选节奏，不把快当标准。可共存，不排勇敢、身体能力；并列不确立创伤、伤史、不指导健康决定。

title.en: A preferred tempo may change next time

paragraphs.en: A slower round today does not become a permanent limit, and choosing a quicker paper turn tomorrow does not prove recovery or progress. Ask again when the activity changes. Your count cannot establish fearfulness, exceptional speed or a need to take a risk. A lower count does not mean recklessness, and a tabletop preference offers no basis for judging another person’s body or medical choices.
paragraphs.zh: 今天慢轮不成永久限制，明天快纸回合也不证明康复、进步。活动变时再问。次数不确立胆怯、超速、冒险需要；低计数不表示鲁莽，桌面偏好不据以评别人身体、医疗选择。

title.en: Try an agreed pace without a race

paragraphs.en: For a harmless optional paper session, choose a pace with willing participants and state how to pause or pass. After one round, check whether the tempo made the activity enjoyable and choose again. No stopwatch or physical challenge is required. This is feedback on a game format, not rehabilitation, sports coaching, medical advice or a test of your courage in facing something difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 无害自愿纸活动中，与愿意者选节奏，说明怎样暂停、略过。一轮后核是否好玩、再选，不需秒表或身体挑战。这反馈玩法，不作康复、体育教练、医疗建议、不测面对困难的勇气。

paragraphs.zh: 完成21情境，每项明确映射选择给七人物中一位加一次原始次数，总计21次。每人物出现12次、每答位3次；当题未出现不算被拒绝。所有最高有全文；全A各3次，七方并列。次数描述原创题本，不是匹配百分比、人群常模、运动能力、自我水平或经验证人格差异。
